Madonna, thought I, must be the secret name of the dancing girl with whom the dean was in love, or some such thing. Placing his favorite geisha under a pine tree on an uninhabited island, Red-shirt stares at her admiringly at a short distance in order to give the picture a good effect. This would be quite ideal to him, and if Noda, the artist, represented the scene in an oil painting and exhibited it at an art gallery, it would be the climax of Red-shirt's happiness.
